name: Pretty Flap ~Chocolate Taste~
original_name: Pretty flap ～チョコレートテイスト～
source:
The protagonist Kasuga Miyu is a totally ordinary girl that became a fourth-year Asagiri University student this spring. She was blessed with good friendships, and maintained her grades so she'd be able to graduate without a doubt... That said, the job hunting she had started since winter in her third year was currently her biggest problem. This is because she hadn't received a single job offer.

Now that she was in her final year, Miyu began to panic. But what did she want to do? Where did she want to be in the future? Without a clear goal of what she wanted to achieve, time was wasted and aimless days just passed her by.

However, Miyu's peers- her classmates, her junior and a kind older friend of hers- all of which she had not seen as love interests, cheered her on and gradually she was able to narrow down what she wanted to do.

And with the guy she became the closest to during this time, feelings beyond friendship had started to grow...

[Translation of official website summary.]
translation:
主人公春日美优原本只是一名普通少女，今年春天升入朝雾大学四年级。她拥有珍贵的友情，成绩也保持得很好，毕业肯定不成问题…话虽如此，从大三冬天开始的求职活动，如今却成了她最大的烦恼，因为她至今没有收到任何一家公司录用。

进入最后一个学年后，美优开始焦虑。但她究竟想做什么？将来又希望身处何方？她没有明确目标，不知道自己想要实现什么，只能任由时光流逝，在漫无目的的日子里虚度光阴。

然而，那些过去从未被她视为恋爱对象的人——同班同学、学弟和一位温柔的年长朋友——都在鼓励她。美优也逐渐明确了自己真正想做的事情。

在此期间，她与其中一名关系最亲近的男性之间，也开始萌生超越友情的感情…

[翻译自官方网站简介。]
